verdict.rationale: Slate's onboarding lets users pick a personal subscription (ChatGPT/Codex or SuperGrok) or Slate credits as the model source, which suggests access without managing raw API keys. The evidence does not explicitly describe a sign-in flow, a free tier, or the absence of API-key handling. missing for 10: explicit documentation of account sign-in/OAuth, any free-tier access or limits, explicit statement that no API keys are needed, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sign in with a personal account to get free-tier access without managing API keys
